data.name: Yugant
data.gender_notes: Yugant is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Yugant refers to the end of one cycle or age and the beginning of another. It signifies the continuous cycle of time and the idea of progress and change. The name Yugant carries the meaning “Age, Cycle, Time” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Yugant usually hope their child will grow to embody age, cycle, time and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Hinduism, Yugant represents the end of one yuga or age and the beginning of another. It signifies the cyclical nature of time and the continuous progression of the universe.
data.etymology: Yugant belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Age, Cycle, Time.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yugant total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The concept of Yugant holds high importance in Hindu teachings, particularly in Vedic and Puranic literature. The belief that the universe goes through periodic cycles of creation, preservation, and destruction is an essential aspect of Hinduism. The idea of Yugant symbolizes the cyclical nature of time and the concept of cosmic renewal. Hindu scriptures describe various Yugas or ages associated with a prevailing moral and ethical order, which change with the end of one Yuga and the beginning of another.
data.spiritual_significance: Yugant is also a deeply spiritual concept that signifies the end of one spiritual cycle and the beginning of a new one. It encourages individuals to reflect upon their spiritual progress and prepare for the next stage of their spiritual journey. This idea fosters an attitude of contemplation, self-reflection, and a desire for personal growth and transformation. The belief in Yugant underscores the Hindu understanding of the cyclical nature of life and the continuing evolution of both the individual and the cosmos.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Yugant signifies the transition or the end of one cosmic cycle and the beginning of another. It represents the eternal cycle of creation, preservation, and destruction in the universe.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Yugant is a Sanskrit term that refers to the end of a yuga or age cycle in Hinduism. The name Yugant carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Yugas are cycles of time in Hinduism, and each yuga is said to last for a specific duration. Yugant refers to the end of a yuga.

trends: The term Yugant is not commonly used in modern Hinduism.
It may be used in academic or scholarly contexts to refer to the end of a yuga.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Yugant remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.
